title: Study of Algorithm for Epilepsy Alert Device
brief_summary: An accelerometer with transmitting ability is worn on the wrist. Data of movements during seizures will be analyzed to upgrade algorithm that will identify seizures.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing Long Term Monitoring for motor seizures

Exclusion Criteria:

* Invasive recording
* Psychogenic seizures
study_population: Patients admitted to Video-LTM Unit with motor seizures.
